forbidden.body: Ask the organisers if you think you should.
setPassword.confirm.title: Finish setting up your account
setPassword.confirm.body: Press the button to continue and choose your password.
setPassword.invalid.title: This link no longer works
setPassword.invalid.body: It was already used or it expired. Ask the organisers for a new link.
setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.error.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setPassword.error.rejected: That password was not accepted. Choose a different one.
setPassword.error.session: Your link has expired. Ask the organisers for a new one.
people.title: People
people.name: Name
people.invite.title: Invite someone
people.invite.ready: Invitation ready. Copy this link and send it to {email}. It works once.
people.invite.existing: {email} already has an account and can sign in now. Send them this address.
people.invite.error.role: Choose a role you are allowed to give.
people.invite.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
people.invite.error.failed: The invitation was not saved. Nothing was changed; please try again.
people.roles.title: Add roles for your team
people.roles.body: This conference only has the Owner role so far. Add the usual starting roles ({termAdvisor}, {termHighCommand} and {termChair}) to invite people with them. You can rename or change them later.
people.roles.error.failed: The roles were not added. Nothing was changed; please try again.
settings.identity.tagline.help: A short line shown under your conference name on the sign-in page.
settings.identity.timeZone.help: Dates and times are shown in this time zone.
settings.locale.defaultLocale.help: The language of your conference's pages.
settings.people.passwordMinLength.help: The fewest characters a password may have (8 to 128).
settings.title: Settings
settings.preview.banner: Preview: you are seeing your unpublished drafts. Nobody else sees this.
settings.saved.draft: Draft saved. It is not live until you publish it.
settings.saved.restored: Restored as a new version. It is live now.
settings.error.fields: Some values are not valid. Nothing was saved.
settings.error.failed: That was not saved. Nothing was changed; please try again.
settings.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to change settings.
settings.error.noDraft: There is no draft to publish.
settings.theme.preset.help: A complete look to start from. The settings below change parts of it.
settings.theme.brand.help: Your main colour, for example #1E40AF. Leave empty to use the preset's. Text colours are worked out for you so they always stay readable.
settings.theme.accent.help: A second colour for highlights, for example #F59E0B. Leave empty to use the preset's.
settings.theme.background.help: A light colour for the page, for example #FFFFFF. A colour too dark for text is lightened. Leave empty to use the preset's.
settings.theme.radius.help: How rounded buttons, fields and cards are.
settings.theme.density.help: How much room controls and cards take.
settings.theme.uppercaseLabels.help: Small labels in spaced capital letters.
settings.theme.contrast.help: High contrast makes text and outlines stronger for easier reading.
settings.theme.colorMode.help: Automatic follows each person's device setting.
settings.theme.adjusted: Some colours were adjusted so that text stays readable. Your choices are kept; the page uses the nearest readable shade.
settings.theme.logo.help: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Shown in the page header and on the sign-in page.
settings.theme.favicon.help: A square PNG, 32 to 1024 pixels, shown in the browser tab. It should still be clear at 16 pixels.
settings.theme.asset.error.type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (a PNG for the browser icon).
settings.theme.asset.error.dimensions: That image is too small or too large.
settings.theme.asset.error.square: The browser icon must be square.
settings.theme.asset.error.upload: The image could not be stored. Nothing was saved; please try again.
settings.theme.headerStyle.help: The bar at the top of every page, with your logo or name.
settings.theme.pageTitle.help: How the title at the top of each page is drawn.
settings.theme.tabStyle.help: How the selected tab is marked.
settings.preview.title: Live preview
settings.preview.help: Updates as you change the design. Nothing is saved until you press Save draft.
settings.preview.sample.title: {termCommittees}
settings.preview.sample.label: Country
settings.theme.customCss.help: For small adjustments the options above do not cover. Allowed: the classes app-header, page-title, tabs, tab, card, card-footer, btn, btn-primary, btn-secondary, input, label, label-text; colours as #hex or var(--s-color-…); spacing, borders, corners, font size, weight and letter spacing. Not allowed: hiding or moving things, images, imports, !important. Text colours must stay readable. Use Preview my drafts to see it. If a change makes the page hard to use, open the settings in safe mode.
settings.theme.customCss.problem.syntax: Line {line}: this CSS cannot be read ({detail}).
settings.theme.customCss.problem.too-lon: The custom CSS is too long ({detail}). The limit is 10,000 characters.
settings.theme.customCss.problem.at-rule: Line {line}: {detail} is not allowed. Only @media with min-width, max-width or prefers-color-scheme.
settings.theme.customCss.problem.selecto: Line {line}: the selector “{detail}” is not allowed. Use the classes listed in the help text.
settings.theme.customCss.problem.propert: Line {line}: the property “{detail}” is not allowed.
settings.theme.customCss.problem.contras: Line {line}: text would be hard to read: {detail}.
safeMode.banner: Safe mode: custom CSS is switched off on this page.
settings.pack.title: Export or import
settings.pack.help: Save this section as a file to keep a copy or use it in another conference. Importing a file creates a draft; nothing changes until you publish it. Logos and icons are not included.
settings.pack.error.format: That is not a Sessional settings file.
settings.pack.error.kind: That file holds a different kind of settings.
settings.pack.error.version: That file comes from a newer version of Sessional and cannot be read yet.
settings.pack.error.invalid: That file contains values that are not valid here. Nothing was changed.
settings.saved.imported: Imported as a draft. Check it, then publish it.
settings.email.title: How emails will look
settings.email.help: Invitations and other emails use your saved design. This sample updates when you save.
settings.email.sample.heading: You are invited to {name}
settings.email.sample.body: Press the button to choose your password and join the team.
app.signIn.title: Sign in to see your conferences
app.title: Your conferences
app.empty: You do not belong to any conference yet. Ask the organisers of your conference to invite you.
app.signInEach: Each conference keeps its own sign-in, so you may be asked to sign in again on its address.
settings.locale.enabledLocales.help: The languages your conference uses, as language codes separated by commas, for example en, es, fr or ar. English and Spanish are built in; for others, write the texts in the translation editor. Missing texts show in English.
settings.terminology.pack.help: The words used for roles and structure across the product. Change any single word below.
settings.terminology.term.help: Leave empty to use the word from the set above. Write it for each of your languages.
settings.translations.messages.help: Change any text of the product, in any of your languages, in the translation editor.
settings.translations.missing: {language}: {count, plural, =0 {complete} one {# text missing, shown in English} other {# texts missing, shown in English}}
settings.translations.overridden: {count, plural, =0 {No texts changed} one {# text changed} other {# texts changed}}
settings.error.languages: Check the language codes: use codes such as en, es, fr or pt-BR, each once, and include the default language.
language.label: Language
language.error: That language is not available here.
translations.title: Translations
translations.help: Write your own text for any line; leave it empty to keep the built-in one (or English). Keep words in braces, such as {example}, exactly as they are: they are filled in by the product. Your texts are saved as a draft of the Translations section; publish it from Settings.
translations.problem.syntax: {key}: this text cannot be read. Check the braces.
translations.problem.arguments: {key}: keep the words in braces as in English.
translations.error.rows: {count, plural, one {# text needs a fix} other {# texts need a fix}}. Nothing was saved.
translations.csv.title: Work in a spreadsheet
translations.csv.error.format: That file is not in the expected layout: the first column must be “key” and the third the translation.
translations.csv.error.empty: That file has no translations to import.
translations.saved: Draft saved. Publish the Translations section in Settings to make it live.
